scope: Labelled origin supplements for February calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 02-01 02-29 listed reviewed February histories without origin wording; r152-data.mjs + build-r152.mjs (round 151 pattern, new O12 bases) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r152.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Skipped: names whose reviewed history already links a word (Laima, Daris, Dedze, Malda, Teri, Helve, Mehis and similar), literary coinages without etymology (Rigonda, Leho) and names with no secure base (Aldonija, Raja, Veronija, Gendrė, Goda, Ülla group, Selmar, Helbe). Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
